notes: Quick background: large fintech platform focusing on personalized customer offers + realtime credit decisions.
Primary ask: dedicated GPU pools with multi-region failover and predictable throughput guarantees.
Target workload: mix of reranking (heavy), short-chat completions, embeddings for search + personalization. Expect high burstiness around peak marketing events.
Throughput targets shared on call: sustained 1200 qps at 4k token window for reranker (batched), 95th pct latency target 120ms for chat flows, p95 < 80ms for embeddings lookup (hot path).

Ops constraints: outbound egress minimization, dedicated VPC peering, strict audit/log retention 7 years, KMS in customer's tenant.
Quote from CTO on call: 'We need deterministic tail latency—best-effort autoscale isn't enough for core credit decisions.'
Security has flagged: must support SSO/SAML, per-route audit logs, and SOC2 evidence prior to production cutover.
Initial cost sensitivity: willing to commit to annual reserved contract if latency/throughput SLOs are SLA-backed; looking for credits for POC run time.

POC proposal: 2-week dedicated pool in us-east1 + us-west1, synthetic traffic generator + live shadowing for 48 hours, run failover drill to validate headroom.
